integrity: All universal width and parity-limit claims are supported by explicit independent-block Gaussian support identities, strict integral convexity, and a triangular-array central limit theorem. The accompanying independent vertex enumerator supplies finite corroboration only. No external mathematical certification has been obtained.
scientific_limitations: Results assume k disjoint even-parity checks with all block lengths at least three and the standard sign-coordinate Euclidean metric. No statement for overlapping checks, non-Gaussian directional laws, or non-Euclidean metrics. Absolute, not relative, mean-width crossover.
title: Sharp mean-width balancing and parity fluctuation laws for block-check codeword polytopes
